[Benzinga news, 2026-10-22T13:02:20Z, by staff] Great Southern Bancorp, Inc. Reports Preliminary Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
Great Southern Bancorp, Inc. announced preliminary earnings of $1.27 per diluted common share for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, noting an impact from non-cash hedge accounting adjustments.
Great Southern Bancorp, Inc. reported preliminary net income of $14.0 million, or $1.27 per diluted common share, for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to $17.8 million, or $1.56 per diluted common share, in the same period of 2025. The company stated that results were negatively affected by non-cash cash flow hedge accounting adjustments. When excluding these specific adjustments, net income for the quarter was $16.5 million, with earnings per diluted common share of $1.50. The company also reported an annualized return on average common equity of 8.68% and an annualized return on average assets of 0.99%. Net interest income for the quarter was $50.3 million, a slight decrease from $50.8 million in the third quarter of 2025, which the company attributed largely to the completion of interest income accretion from a previously terminated interest rate swap.
